app.title: Ambient CSS v3 – Blender meets CSS
app.author: kikkupico
app.description: A CSS animation library that integrates Blender-generated animations into web pages, enabling realistic motion directly in the browser.
proposed_tests: Create a minimal HTML page that imports the library and renders a sample animation
Measure page load time and animation smoothness in headless Chrome
Verify that the library exposes expected CSS classes and animation APIs
